text:
The best pick depends on how you drive and where your phone sits. Prices differ between the guides and within them, so check the current price before you buy.

**Best overall: Anker Prime MagSafe Car Mount Charger (about $70)**
- It's a Qi2 vent mount with active cooling that charges at 15W, or up to 25W in good conditions. It comes with a 60W car adapter.
- MountGuys named it best overall and tested it hands-on. The Gadgeteer also likes its cooling and two-year warranty.
- Its clip is narrow, so check that it fits your vents.
- [Buy (Gadgeteer link)](https://pboost.me/p1SMdJ7da) or [Buy (MountGuys link)](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)

**Best for fast charging on a budget: LISEN Qi2.2 25W Car Mount with fan (about $40)**
- It's a suction-cup mount with a fan, and it includes a 95W adapter. That's the highest wattage on The Gadgeteer's list.
- With the fan off, output drops to 15W, and the base is large.
- [Buy](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Cheapest good option: ESR HaloLock Qi2 (about $20–27)**
- It's a 15W vent or dash mount with strong magnets. It has no cooling and no car adapter, so budget $10–15 for an 18W+ charger.
- [Buy](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20)
- The ESR HaloLock with CryoBoost fan adds cooling for about $36 and is better if you live somewhere hot. [Buy](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)
- A third-party deal page lists code PARTNER18 as taking the CryoBoost model from $39.99 to $32.80 at ESR's store. I haven't verified that code. [Deal page](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other picks**
- **Existing mount arm:** The [PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20) (about $60) has a universal ball joint and no fan, so it may throttle in direct sun.
- **Dash or windshield:** The [iOttie Velox Mini Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20) (about $42) includes a car charger. Windshield mounts are restricted in some states.
- **Cup holder:** The [EXELIQ Cup Holder Charger](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20) is a 15W option, but it puts the phone low, which is poor for navigation.

**Tips**
- Fast charging needs a strong adapter. 25W needs about 45–60W of USB-C power.
- In hot cars, mounts without fans can slow down to about 7W. Choose a fan model if you park in the sun.
- Most of these links are affiliate links, and the Anker Prime was the only mount in the MountGuys guide that I'd call proven in hands-on testing.

If you tell me your phone model, your vent type and your budget, I can narrow this to one pick.

**1. Anker Prime Qi2 (Best Overall, daily commuting)**

- **Pros:** Strong hold, a clip that stays stable on standard slats, and a 60W adapter included in the box.
- **Cons:** Full 25W speed requires a 60W USB-C adapter.
- **Link:** https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa

**2. VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount (Non-Charging Backup)**
- **Features:** Metal-core vent clip, MagSafe-aligned magnets, metal rings for Android and non-MagSafe cases.
- **Pros:** Metal clip resists sagging, and fewer parts can fail.
- **Cons:** No wireless charging, so you need a separate USB-C car charger.
- **Link:** https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F916XVSW/?tag=moun05-20

**3. Andobil Vacuum Suction MagSafe Mount (Dash/Windshield)**
- **Features:** 15W wireless charging, aggressive suction base, 360-degree adjustable head, fits iPhone 12 through 17 Pro Max.
- **Pros:** Places the phone near eye level, and metal ring adapters are included for Android.
- **Cons:** Suction needs periodic re-application, especially after temperature changes.
- **Link:** https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20

**4. RAM Drill Down Mount (Rough Roads and Trucks)**
- **Features:** Bolt-down base with a RAM 1-inch ball system and an optional head.
- **Pros:** The most stable option, with essentially no vibration.
- **Cons:** Requires drilling into the vehicle, so it isn't suitable for leased cars.
- **Link:** https://amzn.to/3O2iQZj

**5. EXELIQ Cup Holder Charger Mount (Cup Holder)**
- **Features:** 15W wireless charging, all-in-one kit, cup holder base with heat dissipation.
- **Pros:** Works when vents or dashboards aren't suitable, and nothing else needs to be purchased.
- **Cons:** The phone sits lower in the cabin, so it suits charging more than active navigation.
- **Link:** https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20
